text: The SUFAL initiative is a multi-partner anticipatory action program aimed at enhancing Bangladesh's capacity to act early based on reliable flood and related hazard forecasts. It focuses on riverine monsoon floods in the Brahmaputra–Jamuna basin and expands to flash floods and lightning in the northeastern Haor wetlands. SUFAL is integrated into Bangladesh's national disaster risk management ecosystem and contributes to the global anticipatory action community.
